determinism.note: Prior GLB hash/bytes were authenticated against its manifest; both GLBs were independently decoded in Blender.

lod.export: LOD15 only; later reduced mode must be separately benchmarked

visualInspection.holes: Boundary edges are recorded programmatically and are not automatically holes; no mesh-repair operation was applied.
visualInspection.invertedNormals: Decoded GLB directed-edge consistency found no same-direction shared edges and no zero-area faces.
visualInspection.lostComponents: All 139 checksum-mapped source meshes imported as one selectable object each. The fixed poster visibly lacks a head and complete distal limbs because this representative scene contains only mapped muscle meshes, not a full-body skin or skeleton layer.
visualInspection.material: One neutral opaque review material assigned to every exported object.
visualInspection.occlusion: Fixed whole-body poster necessarily has anatomical overlap; interactive selection is required for concealed meshes.
visualInspection.proportions: Uniform 0.001 mm-to-m scale only; no coordinate deformation applied.
